weakest_scene.visible_evidence: In mid1 and mid2 a big close-up of Data fills the frame. He holds one crocus with three red sticks floating loosely around his fingers, and the field is pushed to the bottom edge. The 'whole basket of flowers for one pinch' never appears.
weakest_scene.root_cause: The scene shows the 'three threads' half as a gesture and drops the scale claim, a basket of flowers making one pinch. The mascot close-up crowds out the subject.
weakest_scene.repair_goal: Pull the camera back. Have Data pluck the three threads from one crocus into a tiny pinch while a basket of flowers empties beside him, so a basket visibly becomes one pinch. The threads should be held in his grip, not floating.

depictions.note: A real crocus with three threads, but the threads float near his hand and the basket-to-pinch ratio is never shown.
Data hand-plucks threads from heaps of crocus onto a small plate with a clock on the wall. It is made of the subject, but the 'hours' could read stronger.
A balance scale weighs the tiny jar against a basket of flowers. The scale is generic, but the flowers on the pan carry the meaning.

one_line: A well-crafted 3D saffron story where Data does the work, held back by a close-up first beat that never shows the basket-for-a-pinch scale.
problems: seg0 (mid1/mid2): a tight close-up of Data. The red threads float detached around his fingers, and the 'basket of flowers for one pinch' is never shown.
The dawn-and-wilting race beat (seg2) was not visible in the sampled frames, so it cannot be confirmed as shown.
The closing scale sits level in mid5, which says the two sides are equal instead of landing a 'whoa' tip toward the hands.
fixes: seg0: widen the shot and show a full basket of crocus being plucked down to a single pinch of threads. Put the threads in his grip.
seg2: show the flowers wilting across the frame as the sun climbs while Data races to pick them.
Closing: tip the scale toward the flower and labour side to make the payoff land.
